usedFor: Amazon Seller Central holds your orders, and Google Contacts keeps each buyer once “Create Contact” follows “New Order Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each new order adds a contact, so buyers land in your address book without retyping.

watchOut: “New Order Created” is polling, so a new contact appears after the next scheduled check.
